text:
sasha: Quick benchmark heads-up — ran 65B q4f16 on H100 vs A100 across us-west1/eu-west1. p95 latency and throughput look off vs our sims.

mike: what numbers are you seeing?

sasha: pasted warm-run snippets below (concurrency = concurrent requests per GPU):
```
H100 (us-west1)  | conc=12 | p50=95ms p95=210ms | tokens/s=14.8k
H100 (us-west1)  | conc=16 | p50=120ms p95=280ms | tokens/s=18.9k
A100 (eu-west1)   | conc=8  | p50=110ms p95=320ms | tokens/s=11.3k
A100 (eu-west1)   | conc=12 | p50=150ms p95=410ms | tokens/s=13.7k
```

ranjit: are those with flash-attn (FlashAttention3) + KV caching on? which kernel on A100?

sasha: flash-attn3 + local KV cache warm. On A100 we fell back to Triton-attn kernels because our Flash path wasn't compiled for the exact cu version. That explains ~12% p95 delta at conc=16.

eva: did you capture cold vs warm cache numbers?

sasha: warm numbers above. cold p95s were ~30% higher across the board for first 30s of traffic.

ci-bot: ci: perf-run #482 finished — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/482 (graphs + raw logs) :white_check_mark:

mike: ops question — for Dedicated sizing, what headroom do we want for night surge + multi-region failover? current docs say 25% baseline buffer.

ranjit: our rule-of-thumb has been baseline 25% + 15% surge for APAC peaks, but with q4f16 we could reduce base to 20% for serving-only workloads. still need extra for kernel-fallback overhead.

sasha: proposal: set target concurrency per GPU = 12 for H100 65B, 8 for A100 65B. autoscale buffer=30% (covers warmups + kernel fallback). add a routing policy to shift traffic to H100 when eu p95 > 350ms.

sasha: example autoscale snippet to add to Dedicated config: 
```
autoscale:
  target_util: 0.72
  buffer_pct: 30
  max_concurrency_per_gpu: { h100-65b: 12, a100-65b: 8 }
  fallback_policy:
    - condition: region_p95 > 350ms
      action: route_to: preferred_h100_pool
```

eva: also add a kernel-fallback explicit step: if FlashAttn fails 3x in 5m, switch to Triton for that deployment and alert.

mike: :thumbsup: i'll update the Dedicated runbook + capacity spreadsheet and add a canary job for eu-west1.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-update for eu-west1 at 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z (UTC)

sasha: will re-run same benchmark after the canary with both kernels compiled uniformly and post final graphs.

mike: thanks — keep the perf artifacts in the perf-run ticket and tag @oncall if p95 crosses 400ms.
